product: MCP-Zero - MCP zero prompt guide system vanilla

spans.text: Do not provide any other explanation or commentary. Just return the exact tool name that best matches the user's request. If multiple tools could potentially address the request, choose the one that most specifically and comprehensively meets the requirements.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system to not provide any explanation or commentary and to just return a tool name. This removes user agency by not allowing the system to ask clarifying questions when the request is ambiguous, or to present multiple options when several tools could apply. Users have no opportunity to make informed choices.
